blurb: Jensen Performing Arts offers a wide range of dance classes for children, teens, and adults, including ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, lyrical, contemporary, musical theater, and ballroom styles. Classes focus on building confidence, coordination, strength, flexibility, and creativity in a supportive environment. Opportunities to perform at community events, competitions, and year-end recitals are available.
